race.description: Brandt - Emerging Stars Series Heat 7 Mdn Plate
race.comment: FORT OF DREAMS (3) is knocking on the door. He just found one better at Cranbourne last start and will be rock hard fit up on speed. Expect he'll take plenty of running down. DE NIRO (7) is an I Am Invincible gelding on debut for the Hayes yard. Well bred, he's jumped out nicely and the booking of D Lane only adds to the confidence, should run very well. GAMADALE PADDY (8) has placed in both runs this time in at Mildura and Swan Hill. This is a bit tougher but he's on the up and maps for every hope. LAVANCHER (9) made improvement at start two and has claims with further improvement. BLACKBELT (6) is a Wootton Bassett gelding on debut for the Hawkes yard who draws inside and can run well.
